name: mapDeepGet
summary: Reads a value out of a nested map by following a chain of keys.

arguments.name: $keys
accepts: one key per level of nesting

examples: $theme: (card: (padding: 16px, radius: 8px)); .a { padding: mapDeepGet($theme, card, padding); border-radius: mapDeepGet($theme, card, radius); }
caveats: No map the library ships is nested any more: the phone and tablet maps held one entry per device until 4.0.0 and now hold the screen as two lengths. The function is for a map of your own.
